items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: No I played with Benny too, that's my boy. We used to work for the, across the river.

ctx.x: No, that's really hard work according to Benny.
Yeah Benny Turner stayed there, because he didn't do nothing with the car, but he's great, he's great. He's great.
You like the way he's been? Mm-hmm. Yeah. Mm-hmm.
